title: Svalbard Treaty
summary: The Svalbard Treaty was adopted in Paris in 1920. It recognised Norway as full and unqualified sovereign of the previously terra nullius Spitsbergen archipelago, including Bear Island, while giving citizens of signatory powers equal economic rights and access to resources, and limiting taxes to the cost of governing.

as_recorded.value: the Svalbard Treaty was adopted in Paris

importance.justification: Established Norwegian sovereignty over Svalbard with a lasting international legal regime of non-discrimination.
